stories.title: Alexander brothers each sentenced to 30 years in prison for sex trafficking
stories.summary: Real-estate brokers Alon, Oren and Tal Alexander were each sentenced to 30 years in federal prison in the sex-trafficking case that drew international attention.

stories.title: Pentagon tells Congress US war on Iran has cost at least $47 billion
stories.summary: A U.S. Central Command estimate shared with Congress puts the cost of the war against Iran at $47 billion, up more than $3 billion in a month, with roughly $29 billion going to munitions replacement.

stories.title: Netanyahu's bloc leads Israel election but short of a majority
stories.summary: With 99% of ballots counted, Benjamin Netanyahu's Likud-led bloc holds 53 of 120 Knesset seats as officials begin tallying roughly 480,000 absentee ballots that could still shift the result.

stories.title: Fluidstack targets $40B valuation, up from $18B in September
stories.summary: Leopold Aschenbrenner's Situational Awareness fund is pitching investors on a new Fluidstack round that would value the AI infrastructure provider at $40 billion, roughly doubling its September valuation.

stories.title: Cohere opens $5B Series E at $20.5B valuation, with Canada pledging $1.14B
stories.summary: Cohere completed the first close of a Series E expected to total up to $5 billion at a $20.5 billion valuation, with Canada committing up to $1.14 billion toward the round.

stories.title: Mistral releases open weights for trillion-parameter 'Le Chonk' model
stories.summary: Mistral released the weights for Mistral Large 4, a 1-trillion-parameter multimodal model nicknamed 'Le Chonk,' under a modified MIT license that lets companies self-host it.

stories.title: Qwenputer: a functioning, deterministic RISC-V CPU inside Qwen3.5
stories.summary: A hobbyist project demonstrates a functioning, deterministic RISC-V CPU implemented inside Qwen3.5's transformer, topping Hacker News with 344 points.

stories.title: Ryan Day still won't name a starting QB for Ohio State's game at USC
stories.summary: Ohio State coach Ryan Day declined to name a starting quarterback for Saturday's game at USC, saying both Luke Fahey and Tavien St. Clair remain options after Julian Sayin's season-ending injury.

stories.title: Devin McCuin: 'not much of a drop-off' at quarterback for Ohio State
stories.summary: Receiver Devin McCuin said there is not much of a drop-off between Luke Fahey and Tavien St. Clair as the Buckeyes prepare for USC without injured starter Julian Sayin.

stories.title: Jackson and Siereveld cleared to return vs. USC; Timmons and Inniss questionable
stories.summary: Ohio State's availability report clears Kenyatta Jackson Jr. and Austin Siereveld to play against USC, while Jay Timmons and Brandon Inniss are listed as questionable.

stories.title: No. 2 Buckeyes visit USC in the Big Ten's biggest game of the week
stories.summary: No. 2 Ohio State visits Southern California with an unsettled quarterback situation, headlining the Big Ten's marquee game of Week 9.

stories.title: Steiner backs Antonelli to surpass Vettel's four F1 titles
stories.summary: Former Haas team principal Guenther Steiner says Kimi Antonelli has the talent to surpass Sebastian Vettel's four Formula 1 championships.

stories.title: Antonelli skips Mexico GP media day with illness
stories.summary: Kimi Antonelli skipped Thursday's Mexico City Grand Prix media day because of an illness, as the Mercedes driver stands on the brink of clinching his first world championship this weekend.

stories.title: Ricciardo would consider a comeback at Le Mans
stories.summary: Daniel Ricciardo says he would consider a return at Le Mans, leaving the door open to endurance racing after his abrupt 2024 F1 exit.

stories.title: The 10 key moments that defined Sergio Perez's F1 career
stories.summary: Ahead of his 300th career start and Cadillac homecoming in Mexico City, Motorsport.com revisits the 10 key moments that defined Sergio Perez's F1 career.

stories.title: Escape from Tarkov Patch 1.3.0.0 adds Halloween event and PvE PMC bots
stories.summary: Battlestate Games released Patch 1.3.0.0 with a new Halloween in-game event, a switch to fall weather, and high-difficulty PMC bots in the PvE Zone.

stories.title: Columbus schools weighs building closures as part of $50M in cuts
stories.summary: Columbus City Schools is weighing building closures as part of $50 million in planned budget cuts, a move that could reshape the district.

stories.title: Trump touts Ramaswamy and Husted during Ohio midterm rally
stories.summary: President Trump touted GOP candidates Vivek Ramaswamy and Sen. Jon Husted during a rally in Chillicothe ahead of next week's midterm elections.

stories.title: CCS considers eliminating yellow buses for high school students
stories.summary: Columbus City Schools is considering ending yellow-bus service for roughly 9,000 high school students as it weighs transportation changes tied to budget cuts.

stories.title: Ohio SNAP changes raise concerns about store restrictions
stories.summary: Changes to Ohio's SNAP benefits are raising concerns that new store restrictions could limit where some families can use food assistance.
